There was some relief for investors Tuesday as Asian stocks rebounded. Japan's nicer index was up around 6% in early trade. Tech stocks were among the risers following gains for US peers. Chip gear maker Adventest leapt as much as 11%. Markets in China gained too with Hong Kong's Hangen index up around 2.5% early on. It all came after a day of wild volatility on Wall Street. Equities there swung between gains and losses, at one point soaring on a report Donald Trump would delay imposing tariffs [...] # Asian markets jump after day of wild volatility on Wall Street |REUTERS
